summary: Backend-only verification of the rewritten POST /api/li-search/message/script that now generates a DOM-based LinkedIn messaging-overlay auto-send script (no Voyager API, no page navigation). Updated /app/backend/tests/test_message_script.py: replaced obsolete TestVoyagerAPIScript with TestDOMComposeScript covering the 7 requested assertions. Ran pytest: 15/15 passed (0.89s).

minor.issue: Recipient identification uses only the first two space-delimited words of `name` for typeahead; recipients with same first+last name may match the wrong person. Consider preferring public_id or full name.
No server-side limits on message length or recipients array size (DoS surface, though endpoint is internal).
profile_url / public_id fields are embedded into the script but never actually used by the DOM automation flow — dead data in the generated JS.

critical_code_review_comments: Script correctly avoids voyager/api/messaging and identity/profiles (which returns 410 Gone) — good pivot to DOM.
Uses json.dumps for both message and recipients — safe against backticks/${}/newlines/quotes.

innerHTML assignment on the msg contenteditable box uses `message.replace(/\n/g, '

')` — since `message` is a JS string variable (not user-supplied HTML), XSS surface is limited, but note that any '<' in the user's message will be interpreted as HTML in the compose box. Consider escaping < & > before wrapping in

.

Only the first two words of the recipient name are typed into typeahead (`name.split(' ')[0] + ' ' + (name.split(' ')[1] || '')`); can misfire for common names — recommend typing full name or falling back to public_id search.
No retry / verification that the suggestion actually corresponds to the intended recipient (public_id is available but unused).
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_message_script.py now has TestDOMComposeScript instead of TestVoyagerAPIScript. Assertions verify: no voyager/api/messaging, no identity/profiles, presence of 'typeahead', 'contenteditable', 'msg-form__send', absence of window.location, and json-escaped multiline/special chars. Generator lives at /app/backend/routes/linkedin_search.py lines 1327-1431. Regression checks: /api/health healthy, /api/li-search/posts >=20.
